acip: ,JI LTAR RAB RIB MTHU YIS 'GA' ZHIG SKRA SHAD ZLA GNYIS DANG, ,RMA BYA'I MDONGS DANG SBRANG MA LA SOGS LOG PAR 'DZIN BYED PA, ,DE BZHIN DU NI GTI [209b] MUG SKYON GYI DBANG GIS MI MKHAS PAS, ,'DUS BYAS LTA ZHIG SNA TSOGS BLO GROS KYIS NI RTOGS PAR 'GYUR,
english: It's possible For some people, By force of a cataract, To be made to hold, Mistakenly, A strand of hair, One moon as two, The pattern Of a peacock's feathers, A random fly, or Something of the like [f. 209b]. The same sort of thing Happens with those Who are not wise, Due to the problem Of their dark ignorance. They perceive Various objects Like produced things With their intellect.
